title: Great Barrier Reef Recovery Takes 10 Years—Bleaching Returns Sooner
hook: New bleaching can arrive before damaged coral rebuilds.
closing: Repeated bleaching can strip reefs of the recovery time their ecosystems need.
question: Can the reef recover fast enough?

segments.say: The reef suffered 3 mass bleaching events this decade. A once-rare shock is becoming routine.
The longest recorded bleaching gap was 14 years. That breathing room has collapsed.
A reef typically needs 10 years to recover. Repeated bleaching can arrive before damaged coral rebuilds.
